Method of Attack: Root infected devices to take complete control
Evade detection using code abstraction and anti-emulation checks
Harvest and send system information to command-and-control (C2) server
Use exploits targeting vulnerabilities including CVE-2020-0041, CVE-2020-0069, CVE-2019-2215
Gain privileged access to Android OS to grant dangerous permissions or install additional malware
Monitor notifications, capture screenshots, record screen, lock device, reset device password
Attack Vector: Bundled with 19 utility apps distributed via Google Play and third-party app stores (Amazon Appstore, Samsung Galaxy Store, Aptoide, APKPure)
User installs and opens the disguised functional apps
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious apps removed from Google Play Store after Lookout report
Apps included password managers, data savers, app launchers
Lite Launcher app with over 10,000 downloads used to deliver malware
